rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an outcome that happens in the end.

example.english: I waited for you for so long, and eventually you agreed.
example.traditional: 我等咗你好耐，最後你都肯答應。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 hou2 noi6 zeoi3 hau6 nei5 dou1 hang2 daap3 jing3

rows.note: Use this when the result finally happens after waiting, trouble, or delay.

example.english: I queued for an hour, and eventually I managed to buy tickets.
example.traditional: 排咗成個鐘頭隊，我終於買到飛喇。
example.jyutping: paai4 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 tau4 deoi6 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 maai5 dou2 fei1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when something is regarded as inevitable and will happen sooner or later.

example.english: You will eventually understand why I did this.
example.traditional: 你遲早會明白我點解咁做。
example.jyutping: nei5 ci4 zou2 wui5 ming4 baak6 ngo5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 zou6
